commands.name: status
commands.summary: Engine state, rules summary, shortcuts, recent activity (rule IDs and outcome codes only) and sign-in start; works without the app

commands.name: health
commands.summary: On-demand check of the running app: identity, hook thread, callback timing, dropped signals, wake-ups and CPU time

commands.name: engine.start
commands.summary: Turn the engine on in the running app (never starts the app)

commands.name: engine.pause
commands.summary: Pause all rules except engine-control rules; held keys are released

commands.name: engine.resume
commands.summary: Resume a paused engine (never turns it on)

commands.name: engine.stop
commands.summary: Turn the engine off: remove the hook, release held keys, cancel runs

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: End the running tray app (the engine is turned off first)

commands.name: startup.status
commands.summary: Whether the tray app starts at sign-in (HKCU Run value)

commands.name: startup.enable
commands.summary: Opt in: start the tray app (engine off unless engine_on_start is on) when you sign in

commands.name: startup.disable
commands.summary: Stop starting the tray app at sign-in

data.summary: Pre-alpha engine: status, health and engine start/pause/resume/stop of the running tray app over a local pipe, and opt-in start at sign-in; runs engine-control rules only
